blocks.text: Each threat works differently. Spam is easy to recognize because it arrives in bulk with unwanted adverts and odd offers; spyware runs quietly in the background with no obvious signs. Spam aims to sell or trick, spyware secretly gathers personal information, cookies collect browsing habits, phishing deceives you into revealing details, and pharming redirects you to fake sites to steal information.

blocks.prompt: Which threat is hardest to notice, and why?
blocks.explanation: Spyware, because it works silently in the background without obvious signs, unlike spam, which arrives openly.

items: Threats differ in method and aim: spam visible, spyware hidden, cookies track, phishing deceives, pharming redirects.
